plan.data: new invented 8-component tensors only; no patient input
plan.native_loss: unchanged native main NLL / B + native auxiliary loss
plan.regularizer_reduction: mean over the two prediction-path modality outputs
plan.slotbert_scope: Eq11 loss transplant only; batch examples replace frames; diagonal retained
plan.slotbert_weight_boundary: weight 1 is this experiment's preset, not the paper default 0.01
plan.probe: same shared per-slot MLPs in all arms; slots are the only decoder input
plan.probe_updates: detached-slot probe step, then frozen-probe core step
plan.set_targets: WSI per-case raw-token farthest/Lloyd clusters; OMIC raw pathway set
plan.target_component_labels: not used by training; train-mean oracle dictionary is evaluation only
plan.pairing: same seed-specific initial core/probe states, generated inputs, batches and step RNG
plan.selection: fixed final step; no heldout tuning or best-checkpoint selection
plan.effective_rank_definition: angular participation ratio K^2 / sum(G^2), not algebraic rank
plan.content_boundary: probe and donor checks measure generated content, not survival relevance
plan.comparison_boundary: new richer benchmark; do not merge historical S0-S6 measurements

validation.initial_test_run: 25 pass, 1 dtype check fail; fixed before training

boundary: R0-R5 are fixed-weight exploratory candidates on an easy eight-component toy; native outputs and eight slots retained. Content probe is not a survival-information guarantee.
